verification_evidence.real_zotero_lookup: Ingested a fixture PDF via --zotero 4JFAFMBY (a real Zotero key present in ~/Documents/Zotero, resolved via the zot CLI/zotero-read.sh item command) into a scratch corpus, with a scratch zotero-library.json mapping that key to the fixture PDF for the legacy PDF-resolution step. Resulting parent entry: title='Guide to Ground', authors=['Kit Fine'] (editors Fabrice Correia/Benjamin Schnieder correctly excluded), year=2012, metadata_status='resolved', zotero_key='4JFAFMBY'.
verification_evidence.briefing_renders_real_metadata: literature-briefing-invoke.sh (per-repo mode) against the scratch corpus renders '**Guide to Ground** (2012) — Kit Fine', not the bare id and '(?)'.
verification_evidence.honest_partial_no_zotero: Ingested a second fixture PDF via the plain local-PDF path (no --zotero flag): parent entry has title=<bare id>, authors=[], year=null, metadata_status='unresolved', no zotero_key field -- no fabricated values.
verification_evidence.validate_authors_shape_clean: Ran the Phase 7 --validate authors-shape check against the scratch index (both entries): 0 authors_shape_warnings, 0 schema_shape_defects.
